requirements.statement: Under Network::Ip no Unix socket outside ipc.unix_sockets MUST be reachable on macOS, T1 or T2, while IP connects, listening and name resolution MUST work.

acceptance.then: the IP operations succeed and the Unix connect fails on every tier
acceptance.when: the child connects over TCP, listens, resolves a name and connects to a Unix socket

acceptance.given: Network::Ip with ipc.unix_sockets naming a socket
acceptance.then: it connects (T1 and T2 from ABI 9, macOS)

tasks.text: [SR-001] [SR-003] [US2] Linux lowering: socket families, no namespace, socket classes off, `ipc.unix_sockets` below ABI 9 — crates/procage-policy/src/{linux,lower/linux}.rs
[SR-001] [US2] macOS lowering: IP addresses and the resolver socket — crates/procage-policy/src/lower/macos.rs
[SR-001] [SR-003] [US2] Lowering tests on every target, and `Ip` in the socket-class matrix — crates/procage-policy/tests/{network_ip,sockets}.rs
[SR-001] [US2] Canaries: TCP, UDP, listen, a name, Unix (pathname, abstract, engine) refused, `ipc.unix_sockets` allowed — crates/procage/tests/escape_{linux,macos}.rs

existing_verification.justification: Under Network::Ip the caged child connects over TCP, sends UDP, listens and resolves a name, while connects to a fake bus, a fake engine and an abstract bus fail with EPERM on T1 and T2 (container lanes), and on macOS to the engine and another listener; the project's socket at ipc.unix_sockets connects (macOS, T1; T2 below ABI 9 is the expected gap).

requirements.statement: Relax::no_unix_sockets MUST answer hd-service-handoff and hd-container-engines gaps only under Network::All, by switching the policy to Network::Ip; under any other network the gap MUST stay.

acceptance.given: T2, Network::All and a session bus socket in a runtime directory
acceptance.then: the cage is made with Network::Ip, the gap is reported relaxed with the T1 lift, and the child cannot connect to the bus

acceptance.given: a socket-class gap and a Loopback network
acceptance.then: the gap is returned unanswered and the policy is unchanged

tasks.text: [SR-002] [US1] Fitting tests: answered under `All`, refused under `Loopback`; T2 with a fake bus and engine — crates/procage-policy/tests/fit.rs, crates/procage/tests/escape_linux.rs

existing_verification.justification: On T2 with a fake bus and engine, fit without a relaxation fails with the gaps; with no_unix_sockets it relaxes both with NoUnixSockets and the T1 lift, and the child reaches TCP but gets EPERM on both sockets. Under Loopback the gap is returned unanswered and the policy is unchanged.

requirements.statement: On Linux, Network::Ip MUST refuse every socket family but AF_INET, AF_INET6 and, with ipc.unix_sockets, AF_UNIX; ipc.unix_sockets with Network::Ip on T1 below ABI 6 MUST be unsupported.

acceptance.given: Network::Ip lowered for T1 and T2
acceptance.then: seccomp refuses socket() except AF_INET and AF_INET6 (and AF_UNIX with ipc.unix_sockets), even with socket-families waived

acceptance.given: Network::Ip with ipc.unix_sockets on T1 at ABI 5

existing_verification.justification: The plan's only socket rule allows exactly AF_INET and AF_INET6 on T1 and T2, also with socket-families waived, plus AF_UNIX with ipc.unix_sockets; T1 at ABI 5 and T2 at ABI 8 report ipc-unix-sockets unsupported, T1 at ABI 6 an approximation.
